title: 第二十九章 羽山飞鸟第二十八章 尧光之玉
lines: 第二十九章：羽山飞鸟
离开尧光之山的能量场，空气中的金属味被一股强烈的、类似臭氧和烧焦羽毛混合的气味取代。
黄海涛按照“步天图”的指引，穿过一片干涸的、布满龟裂纹的盐碱地，眼前出现了一座通体赤红的山峰。山体呈现出一种诡异的琉璃化状态，仿佛曾被极高的温度瞬间熔化后又急速冷却。这就是《南山经》中记载的“羽山”。
“又东五百里，曰羽山，其下多水，其上多雨，无草木，多蝮虫。”
但眼前的景象，与经文描述的“多蝮虫”截然不同。
整座山峰被一层厚厚的、灰白色的鸟粪覆盖，远远看去，像是一座积雪的山。空气中充斥着尖锐的、此起彼伏的鸣叫声，那声音不像普通的鸟类，而像是金属摩擦和婴儿啼哭的混合体，听得人头皮发麻。
黄海涛刚踏上山脚，一群巨大的黑影就从头顶呼啸而过。
那是羽山飞鸟。
它们的体型像鹰，但翅膀呈现出一种病态的金属灰色，羽毛边缘带着锯齿状的硬刺。最诡异的是它们的头部——没有喙，取而代之的是一张横向裂开的、像吸尘器口一样的圆嘴，嘴里没有舌头，只有一圈圈高速旋转的、像砂纸一样的黑色肉垫。
“食腐者……”黄海涛想起陈宇在尧光山提到过的“清道夫”，看来这类生物在这个世界并不少见。
他刚躲到一块巨石后，那群飞鸟就发现了他。它们并没有立刻俯冲攻击，而是像一支训练有素的空军编队，在空中盘旋，发出那种令人心烦的鸣叫。
紧接着，更多的飞鸟从山体的洞穴里涌出。很快，整个天空都被这些金属怪鸟遮蔽，只留下一个旋转的、灰色的漩涡。
“它们在……包围我？”黄海涛握紧了石矛，但面对铺天盖地的敌人，这点武器显得如此苍白。
就在这时，山体的一个隐蔽洞穴里，突然射出一道耀眼的闪光。
啪！
一只飞在最前面的怪鸟应声坠落，在空中炸成一团黑色的火焰。
“趴下！”一个熟悉的声音大吼。
黄海涛下意识地扑倒在地。紧接着，一阵密集的射击声从那个洞穴里传来。不是枪声，而是某种高压气体发射的声音。
他抬头看去，只见一个穿着破烂迷彩服、脸上涂满油彩的身影，正蹲在洞口，手里端着一把用各种零件拼凑起来的、造型古怪的长管武器，正对着空中的鸟群进行点射。
是张弛。
但他已经不是那个在猾褢巢穴里奄奄一息的怪物，也不是那个在尧光山见到的守山人。此刻的他，像是一个在废土中挣扎求生的战士。他的半边身体依然覆盖着鳞片，但另一边却裸露着血肉模糊的伤口，显然经历过激烈的搏斗。那把武器，是用“尧光之玉”的碎片和某种金属管材焊接而成的。
“还愣着干什么！”张弛头也不回地吼道，又一枪击落一只俯冲的怪鸟，“这鬼东西的‘酸雨’要来了！不想被腐蚀成骨头就赶紧进来！”
黄海涛顾不上多想，连滚带爬地冲进那个洞穴。
刚一进洞，身后就传来一阵“噼里啪啦”的爆响。
回头望去，只见那些飞鸟在接触到洞口附近的空气时，突然像被无形的火烧到一样，发出凄厉的惨叫，纷纷坠落燃烧。空气中弥漫开一股浓烈的硫磺和烧焦蛋白质的味道。

Chapter 29: Birds on Yushan Mountain
1.
Leaving the energy field of Yaoguang Mountain, the metallic smell in the air was replaced by a strong smell that resembled a mixture of ozone and burnt feathers.
Following the guidance of the "Bu Tian Diagram", Huang Haitao passed through a dry, cracked salt-alkali land, and a red mountain peak appeared in front of him. The mountain appears in a strange glazed state, as if it had been melted by extremely high temperatures and then cooled rapidly. This is the "Yu Mountain" recorded in the "Nanshan Sutra".
"Five hundred miles to the east is called Yushan. There is a lot of water below, a lot of rain above it, no vegetation, and a lot of insects."
But the scene in front of me was completely different from the "many vipers" described in the scriptures.
The entire mountain peak is covered with a thick layer of gray-white bird droppings. From a distance, it looks like a snow-covered mountain. The air was filled with sharp, one-on-one chirps. The sound was not like ordinary birds, but like a mixture of metal friction and a baby's cry. It made people's scalp numb.
As soon as Huang Haitao stepped onto the foot of the mountain, a group of huge black shadows roared past his head.
That's Asuka Yuyama.
They are eagle-like in size, but their wings are a sickly metallic gray, and their feathers are edged with jagged spines. The weirdest thing is their head - there is no beak, replaced by a round mouth that is split horizontally, like the mouth of a vacuum cleaner. There is no tongue in the mouth, only circles of black flesh pads that rotate at high speed, like sandpaper.
"Scavengers..." Huang Haitao remembered the "scavengers" mentioned by Chen Yu in Yaoguang Mountain. It seems that such creatures are not uncommon in this world.
As soon as he hid behind a boulder, the flock of birds spotted him. They did not dive and attack immediately, but hovered in the sky like a well-trained air force formation, making that disturbing chirp.
Immediately afterwards, more birds poured out of the caves in the mountain. Soon, the entire sky was obscured by these strange metal birds, leaving only a spinning, gray vortex.
"Are they...surrounding me?" Huang Haitao tightened his grip on the stone spear, but facing the overwhelming enemies, this weapon looked so pale.
At this moment, a dazzling flash of light suddenly shot out from a hidden cave in the mountain.
Snap!
A strange bird flying in the front fell down and exploded into a ball of black flames in the air.
"Get down!" a familiar voice yelled.
Huang Haitao fell to the ground subconsciously. Immediately afterwards, a burst of intensive shooting came from the cave. Not a gunshot, but the sound of some kind of high-pressure gas being fired.
He looked up and saw a figure wearing a tattered camouflage uniform and his face covered in oil paint, squatting at the entrance of the cave. He was holding a long-barreled weapon with a weird shape made of various parts and was shooting at the birds in the air.
It's relaxation.
But he is no longer the dying monster in the cunning lair, nor is he the mountain guard seen in Yaoguang Mountain. At this moment, he looked like a warrior struggling to survive in the wasteland. Half of his body was still covered with scales, but the other side was exposed with bloody wounds, obviously having experienced a fierce struggle. That weapon was made by welding fragments of "Yaoguang Jade" and some kind of metal pipe.
"What are you doing standing still!" Zhang Chi roared without looking back, shooting down a swooping strange bird with another shot, "The 'acid rain' of this damn thing is coming! Come in quickly if you don't want it to be corroded into bones!"
Huang Haitao didn't think much and rushed into the cave crawling on his feet.
As soon as he entered the cave, there was a "crackling" explosion behind him.
Looking back, I saw that when the birds came into contact with the air near the entrance of the cave, they suddenly screamed as if they were burned by invisible fire, and they fell and burned one after another. A strong smell of sulfur and burnt protein hung in the air.
